name: Noah Clowney

comment: The Warriors have stopped issuing salary payments to Porzingis, who remains away from the team and is considering retirement, Anthony Slater and Shams Charania of ESPN reported Wednesday.

name: Moses Moody
comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Jimmy Butler III
comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Clint Capela
comment: Capela (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Timberwolves.

name: Kelly Oubre Jr.

name: Johnny Furphy
comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

name: Tyrese Haliburton

name: Noah Penda

name: Izaiyah Nelson

name: Adem Bona

name: Jordan Goodwin

comment: Anderson is questionable for Friday against the Bucks due to illness.

name: Trey Alexander

name: Anthony Davis

name: Justin Champagnie
